INSERT INTO user_behavior_log ( event_time, event_date, event_type, event_target, keyword, page_path, referrer, ip, ip_region, is_china, fingerprint, anonymous_id, session_id, user_agent, device_type, browser, os, duration_ms, extra ) VALUES
( #{it.eventTime}, #{it.eventDate}, #{it.eventType}, #{it.eventTarget}, #{it.keyword}, #{it.pagePath}, #{it.referrer}, #{it.ip}, #{it.ipRegion}, #{it.isChina}, #{it.fingerprint}, #{it.anonymousId}, #{it.sessionId}, #{it.userAgent}, #{it.deviceType}, #{it.browser}, #{it.os}, #{it.durationMs}, #{it.extra} )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM user_behavior_log
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT ip, MAX(ip_region) AS ipRegion, MAX(is_china) AS isChina, MIN(event_time) AS firstSeen, MAX(event_time) AS lastSeen, COUNT(*) AS eventCount, COUNT(DISTINCT page_path) AS pageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(event_time)) AS activeDays, COUNT(DISTINCT anonymous_id) AS anonCount, SUM(event_type = 'page_view') AS pvCount, SUM(event_type = 'search_submit') AS searchCount, SUM(event_type = 'video_play') AS playCount, SUM(event_type = 'category_click') AS catClickCount, MAX(device_type) AS deviceType, MAX(browser) AS browser, MAX(os) AS os FROM user_behavior_log
GROUP BY ip ORDER BY lastSeen DESC, eventCount DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM user_behavior_log
GROUP BY ip ) t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalEvents, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS uniqueIps, COUNT(DISTINCT fingerprint) AS uniqueFingerprints, COUNT(DISTINCT anonymous_id) AS uniqueAnonIds, SUM(event_type = 'page_view') AS pvCount, SUM(event_type = 'search_submit') AS searchCount, SUM(event_type = 'video_play') AS playCount, SUM(is_china = 1) AS chinaEvents, SUM(is_china = 0) AS overseasEvents FROM user_behavior_log WHERE event_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT event_type AS eventType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_behavior_log WHERE event_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT id, title FROM videos WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id, name FROM categories WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(title,''), gif_id) AS title FROM redgifs_videos WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id, title FROM collections WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id, title AS name FROM advertisements WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE id IN #{id}
